claims.statement: For every physical binary shield M of rank m-2, every affine phase, and every Boolean core D, the resulting sign function P satisfies H(P)<=2I(P) and U(P)<=2I(P), without any coordinate-alignment hypothesis.
A rank-one 1x4 shield with a three-bit point defect on each kernel coset has I=2 and H=15/4+(9/16)log2(16/9)>4, refuting extension of the same coefficient-two fiber payment to nullity three.
For every rank-(m-2) shield in the enlarged class, G(P)<=3I(P). The weaker coefficient 2 is exactly false: one six-bit example has G/I=277/96.
No dimension-independent universal control with b<1 of the aggregate upper-set asymmetry mismatch is proved; the new root U endpoint is not restriction closed and does not pay G.
